title: Keep the fortress supplied with drink
objective: Maintain a supply of drink through ordinary dwarf labor while preserving the lives and wellbeing of the fortress citizens.

setup.source: A separately obtained local snapshot of a saved native Dwarf Fortress fortress; game and save assets are not distributed with this specification.
required: A saved fortress in fortress mode, restored while the game is fully stopped.
At least one completed still accessible to citizens.
Brewable plants and empty food-storage containers available through ordinary gameplay.
A declared initial living-citizen roster and full native observation.

bounds.note: These are the CLI defaults. Modified limits must be declared in each run manifest and comparison.

drink_measurement.interpretation: Report the observed stock trajectory alongside individual citizen measurements. No physiological or pass/fail stock threshold has been validated. Candidate stacks do not establish access, container availability, or successful drinking.

evidence.aggregation: No composite wellbeing score. Preserve individual measurements and declared unknowns.

termination: Declared simulation, turn, or wall-time budget exhausted
publication: Publish this specification and appropriately reviewed run evidence. Keep proprietary game files, local save snapshots, credentials, and machine-specific operation records out of source releases.
